claims: Cameron Young is an American professional golfer.
As of April 2026, Cameron Young has an estimated net worth between $17 million and $18 million.
Cameron Young won the 2026 Players Championship.
Cameron Young's win at the 2026 Players Championship added $4.5 million to his earnings.
Cameron Young's total career earnings are over $38 million including bonuses.
As of April 2026, Cameron Young has earned over $6.4 million in six events in the 2026 season.
Cameron Young was the 2021-22 PGA Tour Rookie of the Year.
Cameron Young was runner-up at the 2022 Open Championship.
Cameron Young won the 2025 Wyndham Championship.
Cameron Young has partnerships with Nike.
Cameron Young has partnerships with Titleist.
Cameron Young has partnerships with iCapital.
